opportunities.title: Corpse Flies Are Not a Swarm: The Half-Damage Rule Everyone Gets Wrong
opportunities.why_now: EN World's Halloween roundup just spotlighted corpse flies as a featured spooky-season monster.
opportunities.angle: 60-sec creature tactic short: show the swarm traits block, call out the common houserule error of applying swarm immunity to corpse flies when they're not statted as a swarm, give the correct half-damage/condition-immunity breakdown.

opportunities.title: 'We Don't Sell That Here': The Session Zero Line Your FLGS Already Drew
opportunities.why_now: RPG Evolution's piece on stores refusing to stock certain content maps directly onto the lines-and-veils conversation GMs avoid.
opportunities.angle: Rules-ruling-adjacent short: frame it as a 'table ruling' — how to set content boundaries before session 1 without a lecture, dry delivery, end on a one-liner GM rule.

opportunities.title: Stop Writing Plots. Write Situations. (Sly Flourish Is Right.)
opportunities.why_now: Sly Flourish just published a fresh breakdown of scene/situation-based prep that's catnip for the daily-GM-tip audience.
opportunities.angle: Prep methodology short: contrast a railroaded plot outline vs. a 3-bullet situation, show how it collapses prep time, deliver as a terse 'ruling' on how to run a session, not a book report.

opportunities.title: The Twenty-Sided Tavern Redux Proves Your One-Shot Needs a Gimmick, Not a Plot
opportunities.why_now: RPG Evolution's redux coverage of the Twenty-Sided Tavern format is a timely hook into one-shot design for GMs scrambling before holiday game nights.
